statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-13151 is a stack-based buffer overflow in asn1_expand_octet_string() in libtasn1 4.20.0 (https://gitlab.com/gnutls/libtasn1/-/blob/master/doc/security/CVE-2025-13151.md, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/libtasn1/-/issues/55). Upstream fixed it in libtasn1 4.21.0 with commit d276cc495a2a32b182c3c39851f1ba58f2d9f9b8 (https://gitlab.com/gnutls/libtasn1/-/commit/d276cc495a2a32b182c3c39851f1ba58f2d9f9b8), and Debian backported the fix to trixie in libtasn1-6 4.20.0-2+deb13u1 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-13151, Debian bug #1125063). DHI rebuilds Debian's 4.20.0-2+deb13u1 source. The only libtasn1-6 build published in the DHI Debian repository is that rebuild, on amd64 and arm64 (libtasn1-6, libtasn1-6-dev and libtasn1-bin, plus the libtasn1-6-dbgsym and libtasn1-bin-dbgsym debug-symbol packages); the Debian changelog shipped in its libtasn1-6 package on both architectures carries the 4.20.0-2+deb13u1 entry for CVE-2025-13151. The range ends at that build's version because it is the first, and only, published build and it carries the fix.
